list: Official 55 trophies as published by PlayStation: 1 platinum, 2 gold, 6 silver, 46 bronze.
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI (PSN) trophy list: https://www.exophase.com/game/grand-theft-auto-vi-psn/trophies/
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies: https://psnprofiles.com/trophies/43531-grand-theft-auto-vi
PlayStation — official trophy names, descriptions and grades as published on PSN

roadmap.title: Start clean — opening and Chapter 1
roadmap.text: Play the opening mission Gone Fishing and finish Chapter 1 and Breakfast Run in normal story flow. From the very first hour, start the long counters in the background: discover every new vehicle you drive, take stunt jumps as you pass them, and spend money in shops rather than hoarding it. Keep a rotating manual save before each chapter ends so a one-off story moment can be replayed from a save if you walk past it.

roadmap.title: Chapters 2–4 and the named missions — grab the moment trophies
roadmap.text: Push the story through Chapters 2, 3 and 4 and the named missions The Cartel Heist, Child's Play, Headliners, VCIA Takedown and Operation Savage Glory. While a mission puts you somewhere you may not revisit freely, do its moment trophy there and then: the unscheduled departure at VCIA, the cocktail on Ocean Beach if the scene offers it, and the showroom escape in classic style. These specific-moment trophies are the ones this guide flags as missable, because their official descriptions describe a single scene rather than a repeatable count.

roadmap.title: Strangers and side stories
roadmap.text: Clear every stranger strand as it appears on the map instead of leaving them all to the end: the final missions for Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy and Tyrone, the unique-animal hunt for Bret, and eight full strands in total for the silver Strangers & Freaks. Side content is easiest while the story is still feeding you new areas, money and vehicles.

roadmap.title: Activities sweep — try everything, then master the range
roadmap.text: Sample each of the nine activity types once for Master of None, then work the scored ones: gold in all 42 Shooting Range challenges, a Top Fun drone-race win at all 14 locations, 20 different race wins, a fishing win against Cal, one finished arcade game, and the bowling follow-through at Kolt & Associates. Activities are repeatable, so none of these are missable — they are a patience block, not a risk block.

roadmap.title: Collectibles, exploration and the long counters
roadmap.text: This is the bulk of the platinum. Sweep Leonida area by area so trips overlap: meditate at all 18 spots, complete 3 Collectible Card sets, WAiNK It at 100 locations, discover 100 vehicles, explore all 52 areas, finish 50 Challenges and land 250 stunts. Use the tracker counters in this app as you go — these trophies are lost time, never lost trophies, as long as you start them early (Stage 1) instead of grinding them all here.

roadmap.title: Crime, partners and money
roadmap.text: Do the partner and crime set while you are flush and well equipped: rob 5 Bank Vaults, an Armored Truck and one Illegal Operation for each of the 9 gangs, rob a jewelry store unseen, and run the two partner set-pieces (lose a 4-star Wanted Level together; rob 3 shops back-to-back together). Then close the money loop: launder $250,000 of Marked Bills, spend $100,000 across shops, buy all 8 garage properties and register 10 vehicles on the Scooter Bros app.

roadmap.title: Cleanup, 100%, the final mission and the Platinum
roadmap.text: Sweep what is left with the filters in this tracker: first the missable-flagged moments (reload a Stage 1–2 save if one was walked past), then any vague one-off trophies — the partnership moment, the second-try success and the strange event — then push the completion percentage to 100% for A Long Road. Finish the final mission last so the story trophies close together, and Vice Got a Price! unlocks the moment the other 54 are all earned. Total estimate: 90–130 hours, an estimate built from the official counts (250 stunts, 100 WAiNK locations, 42 range golds, 52 areas) rather than a promise.

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: The platinum itself: it unlocks automatically once the other 54 trophies on this list are all earned, with nothing extra to do in the game. Work it backwards — clear the missable-flagged moments during the story (Stages 1–2 of the roadmap), keep the long counters moving from the first hour, and leave 100% completion and the final mission for the end. Sources: official name, description and grade from PlayStation via Exophase and PSNProfiles (see Sources); this strategy text is our own advice derived from the official list, not copied from any guide.

It is repeatable and not missable; the only cost is patience. trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob five Bank Vaults and escape after each — a silver, and note the official wording: a vault robbery only counts with the escape, so a vault you are caught leaving is practice, not progress. Build a repeatable loop (enter, clear the vault, leave on a prepared vehicle, lose the heat) and run it five times, logging each clean escape in the counter. If a branch ever locks content, the rotating saves from Stage 1 are your insurance. If you finish the story without it, deliberately fail a repeatable attempt once, then succeed on the second try. Buying garages also gives your vehicle collecting a home, which helps Whip It Good habits.
